description: A polyphonic voice that rebuilds an analysed sample from up to 256 sine waves and a noise residual, so pitch and speed can be set apart from each other

params.text: Sets the base pitch of the voice, -5 to +5V; a double-click snaps it to the pitch the analyser found in the sample
Tunes the pitch by -100 to +100 cents; a double-click snaps it to the cents offset the analyser found
Sets the playback speed on an exponential scale, -10x to +10x, with no change to the pitch
Squeezes the volume envelope towards the start or the end of the sample, -100% to +100%
Sets the depth of the fade applied over the last fifth of the sound, 0% to 100%
Curves the fade out from logarithmic through linear to exponential
Sets where in the sample the transient strength applies; a double-click snaps it to the strongest transient the analyser found
Boosts the attack at the transient position at positive values and softens it at negative ones
Sets where the sustain loop falls in the sample; a double-click snaps it to the most stable tonal frame the analyser found
Sets how many sine waves rebuild the sound, a power of two from 2 to 256; fewer partials give a lo-fi tone and cost much less CPU
Sets the level of the residual noise; at 0% the tilt filter is skipped altogether
Balances the residual noise between low and high frequencies
A click plays the sample once through; holding the button runs the sound into its sustain loop
Resets whichever parameters and voices are ticked in the Reset Behaviour menu

inputs.text: Raises the pitch by one octave per volt
A trigger plays the sample once through; a gate held high runs the sound into the sustain loop around the gate hold position
Modulates the depth of the fade out
Modulates the curve of the fade out
Modulates the number of sine waves
Modulates the level of the residual noise
Modulates the tilt of the residual noise
Modulates the playback direction, so an LFO here runs the sound forwards and backwards
A trigger resets whichever parameters and voices are ticked in the Reset Behaviour menu
A trigger on a channel loads the memory bank of that number, and a trigger for a bank with nothing stored does nothing

outputs.text: The resynthesised voice, -5 to +5V and hard-clipped at 10 volts either way
A 1ms 10V trigger when playback reaches the end of the sample, or the start of it when playing backwards

notes: the voice plays analysis data rather than an audio file; drop a .wav, .mp3, .flac or .kapow file onto the module, or use Select Audio File... in the Audio File Processing menu
menu: Polyphony Enabled allows up to 16 voices, counted from the channels on the pitch and trigger inputs
Retriggers Enabled lets a new trigger cut the sounding voice short, and without it triggers are ignored until playback finishes
Memory Banks stores the analysis data and the knob positions in one of 16 slots, and loads a slot back with a 10ms crossfade
Audio File Processing analyses an audio file, loads or saves a .kapow file, and sets whether leading silence is trimmed and at what threshold
Embed Kapow data in patch saves the analysis data inside the patch rather than pointing at a file on disk
Reset Behaviour picks which knobs a reset returns to their defaults
Open Presets folder... opens the folder of .kapow analysis files that ship with the plugin
